purpose: Stage 3 analysis-design key plan based on the Conversation Archive Analysis checklist.

checklist_alignment.next_incomplete_stage: 3. Prepare classification passages and design the analysis.
immediate_work: Sample representative conversations to discover question and context types.
Prioritize answerable questions and practical outputs; populate the analysis matrix.
Keep the user, people discussed, interactions, and ChatGPT as distinct analytical subjects.

adequacy_assessment.reason: The prior plan includes many conversation settings but does not specify how Stage 3 will inspect ordered exchanges, preserve branch/message references, or access representative source text. Metadata keys alone cannot reveal question/context types or support passage-boundary decisions.
